Admiral '''Caelan''' was the former leader of the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] that was shipwrecked on [[Lapidis Isle]], and was lost when the fleet was attacked. The outpost of [[Caelan's Rest]] was named in his honor.

==Caelan's Memorial==
{{Book||height=30em|align=left|content=
Never was there an Admiral so brave, who led his men with respect, dignity and honor.


The [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kingdom of Kul Tiras]] weeps and so too do his brave crew.
}}
